predicted_impacts.reason: ECR-006 names MTR-001 as the primary component and changes its peak power from 8 kW to 10 kW.
REQ-006 has an 8 kW peak motor power baseline matching the motor specification; it requires disposition against the 10 kW target.
The product relationship identifies INV-001 as driving MTR-001; its 150 A peak specification warrants compatibility review.
The released PROD-X1 BOM contains MTR-001, so the product configuration requires review if the motor change is released.
The critical safe power and thermal control requirement warrants review against the increased motor power target.
The critical battery thermal protection requirement merits system-level review for the changed power target.
Historical retrieval identified a high-severity harness temperature-rise record under high-current demand; no direct relationship to this change was established.
